# Ceretha Legacy Academy

Ceretha Legacy Academy is a faith-centered K–8 microschool located in Haines City, FL, built on the belief that Bible and Math are foundational to daily instruction. The school blends a boutique-luxury brand identity with a warm, purposeful atmosphere, guided by Proverbs 22:6 and a mission to raise leaders and restore purpose. Founded by Carrie Riley, the academy offers a rigorous yet nurturing learning environment powered by Prenda, integrating mastery-based math coaching, project-based learning rooted in biblical principles, enrichment clubs, and summer programming — all designed to serve families seeking intentional, values-driven education.

Source: https://example.com

Why Ceretha Legacy Academy



## A Rigorous, Nurturing Environment for K–8 Students




Ceretha Legacy Academy is more than a school — it is a calling. We offer Christian K–8 education rooted in biblical truth, where every subject, every project, and every relationship is guided by purpose. In intentional partnership with families, we raise leaders who are academically prepared and spiritually grounded.




- ### Faith-Centered Instruction Every lesson is anchored in biblical truth. Bible is a core daily subject — not an add-on — shaping how our students understand the world, themselves, and their purpose. Guided by Proverbs 22:6, we train up each child in the way they should go.

- ### Mastery-Based Math Coaching Math is not just taught — it is mastered. Powered by Prenda, our integrated math coaching model ensures each student advances only when they truly understand the material. Coaching sessions run Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday evenings for deeper skill-building.

- ### Project-Based Learning & Leadership Our project-based christian school model brings learning to life through real-world challenges rooted in biblical principles and mathematical reasoning. Students develop critical thinking, collaboration, and the kind of character that defines true leaders.

Our Mission & Vision






# Raising Leaders.Restoring Purpose.










Ceretha Legacy Academy is a faith-centered Christian K–8 microschool in Haines City, FL — a place where rigorous academics and spiritual formation walk hand in hand. We believe every child is called to greatness, and our purpose is to equip them with the knowledge, character, and confidence to fulfill that calling. Rooted in biblical principles and powered by mastery-based learning, we nurture the whole child: mind, heart, and spirit.



Founded by Carrie Riley, our academy blends the warmth of a boutique learning community with the intentionality of a rigorous academic program. Bible and Math are foundational to our daily instruction — not as separate subjects, but as lenses through which every lesson is understood. From project-based learning rooted in scripture to personalized math coaching, every element of our school is designed to raise up the next generation of leaders.



✦

“Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not depart from it.”
— Proverbs 22:6

✦





















Meet the Founder




## Carrie Riley


Founder & Lead Educator, Ceretha Legacy Academy



Carrie Riley founded Ceretha Legacy Academy with a singular conviction: that every child deserves an education rooted in purpose, faith, and academic excellence. Her journey into Christian K–8 education was shaped by years of observing the gap between what children are capable of and what traditional schooling often offers — and a deep calling to bridge that gap for families in Haines City, FL.


Guided by Proverbs 22:6 — "Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it" — Carrie built a learning environment that is both rigorous and nurturing. Through the Prenda microschool model, she has created a boutique-luxury academic experience where mastery-based math coaching, project-based learning, and daily biblical devotion are woven into every lesson.


Carrie believes that raising leaders begins with intentionality — in the curriculum, in the classroom, and in the hearts of the educators who show up every day. She is committed to serving families who seek values-driven education that doesn't ask them to choose between faith and academic rigor.









“Bible and Math are foundational to our daily instruction.”

— Carrie Riley, Founder

Mastery-Based

Our Foundation


## Pillars of a Purposeful Education



At Ceretha Legacy Academy, every decision — from curriculum to culture — is guided by timeless principles. These four pillars shape our learning environment and define how we form the whole child: academically, spiritually, and personally.












### Faith First



Scripture is not a supplement — it is the foundation. Daily Bible devotion and scripture study are woven into every subject, anchoring our students in truth and equipping them to see all of life through a biblical lens. Proverbs 22:6 guides every step.

Proverbs 22:6








### Academic Excellence



We hold every student to a standard of mastery, not just completion. Through Prenda's mastery-based model, rigorous math coaching, and project-based Christian learning, students build genuine competence and the confidence to lead. Mediocrity is never the goal.

Mastery-Based Learning








### Raising Leaders



We are not simply raising students — we are raising the next generation of servant leaders. Through enrichment clubs, project-based challenges, and a culture of responsibility, every child at Ceretha Legacy Academy is shaped with the character and vision to make a lasting impact.

Character Formation








### Family Partnership



Education is a covenant between school and home. We partner closely with families who share our values and commitment to intentional, purposeful upbringing. Open communication, transparent progress, and shared vision are the hallmarks of every family relationship we build.

Community & Covenant

Ceretha Legacy Academy — Academics






# A Rigorous, Faith-Led Learning Experience for Grades K–8



At Ceretha Legacy Academy, every school day begins with purpose. Our Christian K–8 education model is built on the conviction that Bible and Math are foundational to daily instruction — equipping young minds not only with academic excellence, but with the wisdom and character to lead. Powered by Prenda’s mastery-based framework, our boutique microschool environment nurtures each child at their own pace within a structured, nurturing K–8 setting where no learner is left behind and no potential goes unnoticed.

Academics




## Our Core Curriculum


At Ceretha Legacy Academy, every subject is taught with intention — weaving biblical truth and academic excellence into each lesson. Our Christian K–8 education is designed to equip young minds with the knowledge, character, and faith to lead purposefully.













Foundation

### Bible


Scripture is at the heart of everything we do. Daily devotion and structured scripture study form the spiritual backbone of our school day — grounding students in God's Word and teaching them to see all of life through a biblical lens.


- Daily devotion & morning worship

- Scripture memorization & study

- Biblical worldview integration

- Character & leadership formation


"Train up a child in the way he should go." — Proverbs 22:6









Foundation

### Mathematics


Mastery-based math instruction powered by Prenda ensures every student builds genuine understanding — not just procedural fluency. Our integrated math coaching model supports learners at every level, reinforcing the logical, ordered thinking that reflects God's design.


- Mastery-based progression

- Prenda-powered learning platform

- Small-group math coaching

- Real-world problem solving


Coaching: Mon / Wed / Thurs · 3:30–7:00 PM














### English Language Arts


Developing confident communicators through reading comprehension, grammar, vocabulary, and literary analysis rooted in meaningful texts.










### Science


Exploring God's creation through inquiry-based learning, experiments, and discovery — nurturing curiosity and wonder about the natural world.










### Social Studies


Understanding history, civics, and culture through a biblical lens — helping students become informed, principled citizens who honor God in community.










### Reading Lab


Targeted, small-group reading instruction designed to accelerate fluency, phonics mastery, and comprehension for every learner at their level.










### Writing Lab


Building strong writers through structured composition, creative expression, and the development of a clear, purposeful voice across all genres.










### STEM


Hands-on science, technology, engineering, and math projects that challenge students to design, build, and solve — reflecting God's call to create and steward.










### Art


Nurturing creativity as a gift from God — students explore color, form, and expression through visual arts that celebrate beauty and cultivate imagination.










### Physical Education


Honoring the body as a temple — students develop fitness, teamwork, sportsmanship, and a lifelong appreciation for health and physical well-being.










### Leadership


Rooted in servant-leadership principles, this course equips students to lead with integrity, empathy, and purpose — raising the next generation of kingdom-minded leaders.





















Our Daily Rhythm



## A Day at Ceretha Legacy Academy



Our faith-centered K–8 microschool follows a purposeful daily schedule designed to nurture mastery, character, and leadership. Every hour is intentional — grounded in biblical principles and academic excellence.





















8:00 – 8:30 AM

### Morning Devotion


We open each day in prayer and scripture. Bible study is foundational — not supplemental — to our Christian K–8 education.


















8:30 AM – 12:00 PM

### Core Instruction


Mastery-based Math, ELA, Science, Social Studies, Reading Lab, and Writing Lab — taught with rigor and purpose through our Prenda-powered learning model.












12:00 – 12:45 PM

### Lunch & Recess


Rest, nourishment, and play — essential rhythms that restore focus and build community among our students.


















12:45 – 1:45 PM

### STEM, Art & PE


Hands-on learning in STEM, Art, Physical Education, and Leadership — developing the whole child with creativity, movement, and purpose.












1:45 – 3:00 PM

### Enrichments & Clubs


After core day, students explore enrichment clubs and leadership programming — extending learning beyond the classroom in a faith-based microschool community.



















### Math Coaching Continues


Mastery-based math coaching extends on designated afternoons and evenings — Monday, Wednesday & Thursday, 3:30–7:00 PM. Included for microschool students; available to traditional students as an enrichment investment. Because math reasoning is central to every real-world project we tackle.



Mon · Wed · Thu
3:30 – 7:00 PM







“Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not depart from it.”
— Proverbs 22:6























Our Learning Model




## A Foundation Built to Last











### Mastery-Based Progression


Every student advances only when they truly understand — not just when the calendar says so. Our mastery-based math coaching, powered by Prenda, ensures each child builds on a rock-solid foundation before moving forward, eliminating gaps and building genuine confidence.











### Individualized Support & Small-Group Care


As a boutique faith-based microschool, our intentionally small enrollment means your child is truly known — by name, by strength, and by calling. Instruction is tailored to each learner's pace, learning style, and God-given potential within a nurturing, purpose-driven environment.











### Leadership Formation Through Purpose-Driven Instruction


Guided by Proverbs 22:6, every lesson — from Bible devotion to STEM projects — is designed to raise leaders who think with clarity and serve with conviction. Biblical principles and math reasoning are woven into real-world projects, shaping students who are academically excellent and spiritually grounded.














Prenda-Supported Microschool

Our Signature Programs



# Purposeful Learning,Beyond the Core Day






At Ceretha Legacy Academy, education doesn't stop when the core school day ends. Our signature programs extend the mission — weaving together Christian K–8 education with hands-on discovery, mastery-driven coaching, and immersive summer experiences. Each program is designed to cultivate leaders, deepen understanding, and strengthen the partnership between families and school. Whether your child is building real-world skills through project-based learning, sharpening mathematical fluency through personalized coaching, or exploring new passions over the summer, every experience is grounded in biblical principles and intentional academic growth.










### Project-Based Learning


Real-world projects rooted in biblical principles, developing critical thinking and collaborative leadership skills.












### Math Coaching


Mastery-based coaching sessions on Mon, Wed & Thurs — available to microschool students and traditional learners alike.












### Summer Camp


Enriching summer programming that keeps young minds engaged, inspired, and growing in faith through the break.

Academic Framework


## How We Measure Mastery & Enrich the Day











Mastery Scale


### Understanding Our Grading Framework


At Ceretha Legacy Academy, progress is measured not by letter grades alone, but by genuine mastery. Our mastery-based model — powered by Prenda — ensures every student advances only when they have truly internalized a concept, building unshakeable academic foundations rooted in both biblical wisdom and mathematical precision.




4

Mastery
Student can independently apply and extend the concept



3

Proficiency
Student meets grade-level expectations with consistency



2

Developing
Student shows partial understanding; targeted support continues



1

Beginning
Student is introduced to the concept; intensive coaching applied









PBL Grading Categories


### Project-Based Learning Assessment


Our project-based learning model in this Christian K–8 education setting evaluates students across four intentional dimensions, ensuring each child grows in character as well as competence.


- Knowledge & Understanding Demonstrates comprehension of core content and biblical principles

- Critical Thinking & Application Applies math reasoning and scripture to real-world challenges

- Collaboration & Character Models servant leadership, teamwork, and faith-driven integrity

- Presentation & Communication Articulates findings with clarity, confidence, and purpose







Bible principles and math reasoning are integrated into every real-world project, ensuring students connect academic learning to their God-given purpose.










Beyond the Core Day


### Enrichments & Clubs


The core school day runs 8:00 AM – 1:45 PM, anchored in Bible and mastery-based academics. From 1:45 – 3:00 PM, students may remain for enrichment clubs that deepen curiosity, cultivate gifts, and nurture the whole child.






Core Day
8:00 AM – 1:45 PM

→

Enrichments
1:45 PM – 3:00 PM











#### STEM & Innovation Lab


Hands-on exploration of science, technology, engineering, and math through God-inspired creation and curiosity.










#### Creative Arts & Expression


Visual arts, storytelling, and creative writing that honor beauty as a reflection of the Creator.










#### Leadership & Character Club


Developing servant leaders through scripture study, community projects, and purpose-driven mentorship.










#### Reading & Writing Lab


Deepening literacy through literature, journaling, and faith-informed reading that builds vocabulary and voice.










#### Physical Education & Wellness


Honoring the body as a temple through movement, team sports, and healthy habits rooted in stewardship.










#### Worship Arts & Music


Cultivating musical gifts and a heart for worship through singing, instruments, and performance ministry.











Summer Programming — Extended enrichment opportunities are available during summer months, offering continued academic momentum, faith formation, and exploratory learning for enrolled families.

Admissions & Tuition





# Begin Your Family’s Legacy






Ceretha Legacy Academy warmly welcomes families seeking intentional, faith-centered Christian K–8 education in Haines City, FL. Our enrollment is proudly powered by Prenda, a trusted microschool platform that makes joining our academy community a clear and straightforward process. Whether you are exploring your options or ready to take the next step, we are here to guide you every step of the way.

Your Journey Begins Here



## Your Path to Enrollment


Four simple steps to join our faith-centered K–8 microschool community — where leaders are raised and purpose is restored.









01



### Inquire


Reach out to express your interest and learn how Ceretha Legacy Academy's Christian K–8 education aligns with your family's values and vision.
















02



### Schedule a Tour


Visit our campus in Haines City, FL to experience the warm, purposeful atmosphere firsthand and meet our dedicated faculty and founder, Carrie Riley.
















03



### Complete Your Application


Submit your family's application through our secure MemberSpace-linked enrollment form, sharing your child's learning background and goals.
















04



### Finalize Enrollment


Complete your enrollment agreement, explore Step Up UA & PEP scholarship options, and officially welcome your child into our legacy community.

Morning devotion, scripture memorization, and faith integration across all subjects.







Mastery-Based Math
Daily instruction plus Mon/Wed/Thu coaching sessions (3:30–7:00 PM) for microschool students.







Core Academics
ELA, Science, Social Studies, Reading Lab, Writing Lab, STEM, Art, PE, and Leadership.







Project-Based Learning
Real-world projects integrating biblical principles and math reasoning, powered by Prenda.







Enrichment Clubs
After-core enrichment from 1:45–3:00 PM covering creative, athletic, and leadership activities.







Summer Programming
Seasonal enrichment and academic continuity programs available for enrolled families.

Financial Access & Support


## Values-Driven EducationMade Accessible


Ceretha Legacy Academy accepts Florida scholarship programs so every family can access the intentional, faith-centered K–8 education their child deserves — without financial barriers standing in the way.















Step Up UA
PEP



### Florida Scholarship Programs Accepted


We proudly accept the Step Up for Students Unique Abilities (Step Up UA) and Personal Education Program (PEP) scholarships — two of Florida's most impactful education choice programs. These scholarships can cover tuition, making our rigorous, faith-led microschool model accessible to families across Haines City and Polk County.


Whether your child qualifies through unique learning needs or income eligibility, our admissions team will walk you through every step of the scholarship application process with care and clarity.



- Step Up UA — for students with unique learning needs

- PEP — income-based scholarship for qualifying families

- Dedicated support through every step of the application

- Serving grades K–8 in Haines City, FL


Start Your Application













### Powered by Prenda


Our learning model is powered by Prenda — a proven microschool platform built for mastery-based, personalized education. This means your child receives an individually tailored academic path, real-time progress tracking, and a rigorous curriculum that honors both academic excellence and your family's values.


What families receive:
Mastery-based math coaching · Project-based learning · Bible-integrated curriculum · Small class sizes · Enrichment clubs











### Purpose-Driven & Within Reach


We believe no family should have to choose between quality education and their faith. Ceretha Legacy Academy was founded on the conviction that Christian K–8 education — rigorous, nurturing, and biblically grounded — should be within reach for every child called here.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/26/2026



Ceretha Legacy Academy ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Ceretha Legacy Academy

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 26, 2026



Ceretha Legacy Academy is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Ceretha Legacy Academy

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
